view.name: NYPD Officer Profile - Title Shield History
view.description: Table containing information related to the Uniformed Member of Service’s rank/title. This information includes rank/title and the date rank/title became effective as well as shield numbers where appropriate. The term rank is application to uniform MOS and the term title is reserved for civilians.
